render_dynamic_scene: render a dynamic NeRF scene with static and dynamic components using tensorf models and camera poses
evaluate_rendering_quality: evaluate rendering quality by computing PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS metrics for rendered images against ground truth
render_camera_path: render images along a custom camera path with optional time-varying views and save video output
compute_induced_flow: compute induced optical flow by projecting 3D points from one camera view to a neighbor frame image plane
convert_coordinates: convert 3D points between NDC, world, and contracted coordinate spaces for ray marching
